definition: bubbling, boiling water.
example: ಒಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುತ್ತೆಸರ್ ಶಬ್ದ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The bubbling boiling water was making a sound on the stove.

definition: a single fold (of a cloth, paper etc.).
example: ಈ ಸೀರೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ಒಚ್ಚೋಡಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಇಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: She made a single fold in this saree and kept it.

definition: a kind of ornamental cloth.
example_en: They dressed the bride in an ornamental cloth sari.

definition: that which is said; a spoken word or words; speech.
example_en: The disciples listened with devotion to the guru's spoken words.

definition: a seasoned cheat.
example_en: That seasoned cheat easily deceived people.

definition: well-boiled and cooled milk, that has a layer of cream on it.
example_en: Grandmother used to give the well-boiled creamy milk to the children every day.

definition: having a trunk (as elephants).
example_en: The trunked animal was drinking water in the forest.

definition: distinction; recognised superiority; a special quality, feature, point, characteristic, etc.
example_en: His distinguished quality was different from everyone else's.

definition: tears caused by great joy.
example: ಮಗನನ್ನು ಕಂಡ ತಾಯಿಯ ಕಣ್ಣಲ್ಲಿ ಹರ್ಷಾಶ್ರು ಹರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Tears of great joy flowed from the mother's eyes on seeing her son.

definition: to cause to wash (clothes); to get (clothes) cleaned.
example_en: She got the clothes washed by the washerman.

definition: a passage for water.
example_en: The old water passage has been covered with mud.

definition: (astrol.) a conjugation of the sun and moon, in which they are in opposite ayana and have the same declination, the sum of their longitudes being 180 degree.
example_en: The astrologer read about the conjunction of the sun and moon in the almanac.

definition: (obs.) an old tax.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನರು ಕವರ್ತೆ ಎಂಬ ತೆರಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In ancient times people used to pay a tax called kavarte.

definition: a kind of small dagger.
example: ಬೇಟೆಗಾರ ತನ್ನ ಸೂರಕತ್ತಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯ ಚರ್ಮ ಸುಲಿದನು.
example_en: The hunter skinned the animal with his small dagger.

definition: a woman, in gen.
example_en: That woman walked towards the temple.

definition: the quality of being not subject to rules or regulations.
example: ಆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನಿಯಮಿತತೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Irregularity in following rules was clearly visible in that institution's work.

definition: the crescent moon.
example_en: The poet beautifully described the crescent moon in the sky.

definition: to be impeded, obstructed.
example_en: The work was impeded by a small obstacle.

definition: a children's play in which one has to catch others sitting on a tree.
example_en: The children were playing the tree-catching game.

definition: to have a longing for; to desire.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಪುಸ್ತಕವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು ಹಾರವಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He longed to obtain his beloved book.

definition: to get a shelter or protection.
example_en: The orphan child found shelter in that ashram.

definition: a partially insane man.
example_en: That partially insane man wandered about in the street.

definition: an irregular growth of a tooth (over another).
example_en: An irregular overgrowth of a tooth appeared in his mouth.

definition: a large river.
example: ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಬಂದಾಗ ಹೆದ್ದೊರೆ ಎರಡೂ ದಂಡೆ ಮೀರಿ ಹರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: When the flood came, the large river overflowed both banks.

definition: any crop that is cultivated in irrigated land.
example: ಕಾಲುವೆ ನೀರಿನಿಂದ ಈ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ತರಿಪೈರು ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They grow irrigated crops in this field using canal water.

definition: to cause to bend; to make a straight thing turn inward, downward or backward.
example_en: He bent the iron rod.

definition: that which is perceived through the olfactory nerves in the nasal cavity; smell; odour; scent.
example_en: The scent of the flower filled the entire room.

definition: to become completely extinct; to become annihilated; to be destroyed.
example_en: That ancient civilization became completely extinct.

definition: a short spear or javelin.
example_en: The hunter took a short spear and went into the forest.

definition: any article or device used or needed in a given activity as tool, instrument, utensil, etc.; an implement.
example_en: The carpenter kept all his tools in the box.

definition: the fact of knowing another person, but not intimately.
example: ಅವರ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುವುದು ಬರೀ ಮೊಗವಱಿತ ಮಾತ್ರ.
example_en: What exists between them is only a casual acquaintance.

definition: a witty speaker.
example: ಆ ವಚನಚತುರ ತನ್ನ ಮಾತುಗಳಿಂದ ಸಭೆಯನ್ನು ರಂಜಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That witty speaker entertained the assembly with his words.

definition: any of a class of chemical elements, as iron, gold or aluminum, generally characterised by ductility, malleability, luster, and conductivity of heat and electricity; a metal.
example_en: The price of metal rose in the market.

definition: a man guilty of or involved in a treachery.
example: ಆ ಒಳಸಂಚುಗಾರ ರಾಜನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಕುತಂತ್ರ ಹೂಡಿದ.
example_en: That treacherous man plotted a conspiracy against the king.

definition: a Dravidian language spoken by aboriginals in the Nilagiri region in southern part of India.
example: ನೀಲಗಿರಿ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಆದಿವಾಸಿಗಳು ಇರುಳ ಭಾಷೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The aboriginals of the Nilagiri region speak the Irula language.

definition: the chief of an army; a military commander.
example_en: The army commander gave orders to the soldiers.

definition: the plant Atylosia albicans of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: Nellavare plants are growing in the field.

definition: the habit or act of eating too much; gluttony.
example_en: Everyone in the house is fed up with his gluttony.

definition: the Supreme Being.
example_en: A grand festival took place in the temple of the Supreme Being.

definition: a sulphate of copper; blue vitriol.
example_en: The farmers sprayed blue vitriol on the crop.

definition: warded off; fended off; removed; turned aside.
example_en: The enemy's attack was warded off.

definition: zealously engaged in manufacturing, productive, business activity or any other work; employed; occupied.
example_en: He was zealously engaged in the company's work.

definition: to load a burden on; to place a lond on.
example_en: He loaded the burden on the ox.

definition: a thought, plan, scheme pondered over which is not disclosed to another.
example_en: No one came to know her undisclosed plan.

definition: a river in floods.
example_en: During the rainy season the river in floods submerged all the banks.

definition: the quality of being manly.
example_en: Everyone knew his manliness.

definition: a mixture of union; a commixture.
example: ಎರಡು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಗಳ ಸಂಸರ್ಗ ಹೊಸ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The mixture of the two cultures brought new development.

definition: that which is straight.
example: ಆ ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಕೋಲಿನ ಸಯ್ ನೋಡಿ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: They admired the straightness of that bamboo stick.

definition: a grove of mango trees; a mango-orchard.
example_en: There was a vast mango orchard outside the village.

definition: a clever, intelligent man.
example: ಊರಿನ ಶಾಹಣೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೂ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: The village's clever man used to answer every problem.

definition: a string of cotton or metal tied round the waist.
example_en: The waist string got caught around his waist.

definition: moderately cold; not too cold.
example_en: I want moderately cold water, not icy water.

definition: to pour ambrosia on.
example_en: The priest poured ambrosia on the idol.

definition: a looking into closely; an examining carefully; searching; a quest.
example_en: The scientists conducted a close examination of that phenomenon.

definition: a stuffed figure of a man made with sticks, old clothes, etc. set up in a field to scare birds away from crops; a scarecrow.
example: ಹಕ್ಕಿಗಳನ್ನು ಓಡಿಸಲು ತಟ್ಟಿರಾಯವನ್ನು ಹೊಲದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They placed a scarecrow in the middle of the field to drive away the birds.

definition: the front door, gate or entrance of a building.
example_en: The guest knocked on the front door and came inside.

definition: brutal or uncultured behaviour; the quality of a ruffian.
example_en: People used to fear seeing his brutal, uncultured behaviour.

definition: to become stronger; to gain strength; to be strengthened.
example_en: If you exercise, the body becomes stronger.

definition: the apple of the eye; pupil.
example_en: The child's pupil of the eye was shining brightly.

definition: an obedient, submissive man.
example: ಬೞಿಯ ಎಂಬ ಆ ಸೇವಕ ಎಂದೂ ಎದುರಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That obedient servant called baḷiya never talked back.

definition: moving to and fro or from one side to another, (as a wave).
example_en: The moving to and fro waves dashed against the shore.

definition: a loss of the power to remember.
example_en: After the accident he suffered a loss of memory.

definition: not happened, heard of, in the past; having no precedence; unprecedented.
example_en: This development is unprecedented in history.

definition: a man, animal, state, etc. who is freed from bondage, another's control, authority, obligation.
example_en: That slave was finally freed.

definition: obsession - a) the fact or state of being obsessed with an idea, desire, emotion, etc. b) such a persistent idea, desire, emotion, etc., esp. one that cannot be got rid of by reasoning.
example_en: He has an obsession with old coins.

definition: a stream in a forest.
example_en: The deer were drinking water in the forest stream.

definition: scented; perfumed.
example: ಆ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಗಂಧಿತವಾಗಿ ಇಡೀ ಮನೆಯನ್ನು ಸುವಾಸನೆಗೊಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That scented oil perfumed the whole house.

definition: profound dedication; devotion.
example_en: Her devotion to god was unwavering.

definition: a kind of superior quality cloth.
example_en: She wore a sari made of superior quality cloth.

definition: of the colour of smoke; grey.
example_en: The clouds in the sky appeared grey in colour.

definition: a container of earthenware, metal or glass; a jar.
example_en: Mother filled the jar with water.

definition: the fine powder of wheat.
example_en: Mother made puris from fine wheat flour.

definition: a stone slab.
example_en: They had laid a large stone slab in the courtyard.

definition: a (moving) wave; the undulated surface of a body of water.
example_en: A moving wave rose in the river and struck the rock.

definition: founded; instituted; brought into being (on a firm or stable basis).
example_en: This institution is well established.

definition: a brick made to withstand great heat, used to line fireplaces, furnaces, etc.; a firebrick.
example_en: They used firebricks for the furnace's wall.

definition: the act of tickling.
example_en: The elder sister tickled her younger sister and made her laugh.

definition: an arm that is severed from the body.
example: ಅಪಘಾತದ ನಂತರ ಆತನ ಕಡಿದೋಳು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the accident, his severed arm lay on the ground.

definition: (gen.) a bird that has wings.
example_en: Many birds were flying in the sky.

definition: a traditional 'U'-type roof tile.
example_en: They use traditional roof tiles for the village houses.

definition: a coercive obstruction posed against someone from going in or out; picketting.
example_en: The workers picketed in front of the factory.

definition: the cardinal number seventeen; 17.
example_en: There are seventeen children in this class.

definition: a great number of people gathered together; a crowd.
example_en: A great crowd had gathered at the fair.

definition: charges or costs met with in running a business, doing one's work, maintaining property, etc.; expenses.
example_en: This month's expenses have increased a lot.

definition: to feed poison; to give poison to.
example_en: She fed poison to her elder brother and grabbed the property.

definition: something said or written in return to a question, argument, letter, etc.; an answer.
example: ಅವನು ನನ್ನ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಜವಾಬ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He gave a proper answer to my question.

definition: ball-shaped jaggery.
example_en: The ball-shaped jaggery in the shop was like a big ball.

definition: a spiral turn to the left; a sinistrose turn.
example_en: The vehicle took a spiral turn to the left and left the road.

definition: a person belonging to the country Nepal.
example_en: That Nepali trekker climbed the Himalayas.

definition: the mouth that speaks always inauspicious things.
example_en: He has an inauspicious mouth, always uttering ill omens.

definition: a woody perennial plant having a single usu. elongate main stem generally with few or no branches on its lower part; a tree.
example_en: That tree is as old as a hundred years.

definition: Arjuna, the famous hero in the great Indian epic Mahābhārata.
example_en: Arjuna was an unmatched archer in the war.

definition: the act of (air) blowing; air-movement.
example_en: By evening, a cool air-movement began to blow.

definition: a kind of tree.
example: ನದಿ ದಂಡೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಪಳುಕಿ ಮರ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A paluki tree stood near the river bank.

definition: useless talk.
example_en: Don't pay attention to that useless talk.

definition: to break off or separate by or as by splitting; to split off.
example_en: He split the bamboo and wove a basket.

definition: a head of account (in book keeping).
example_en: The accountant wrote every head of account in the book.

definition: a variety of scorpion, that is smaller in size, red in colour.
example_en: The small red scorpion was hiding under the stone.

definition: to determine the position, relatively to fixed or known direction; to orient.
example_en: The sailor oriented the ship with the help of a compass.

definition: the quality or condition of being straight; straightness.
example_en: The straightness of that line was clear in the measurement.

definition: a water jar.
example_en: The priest decorated the water jar with mango leaves.

definition: to be seized or filled with wonder; to wonder.
example: ಆ ಅದ್ಭುತ ದೃಶ್ಯ ಕಂಡು ಅವನು ಮೂಗೇಣಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: Seeing that wondrous sight, he was filled with wonder.

definition: the wealth, as money, property, etc. invested by a promoter of a business; capital.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿ ತೆರೆಯಲು ಬೇಕಾದ ಮೂಲಗಂಟು ಅವನ ಬಳಿ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He did not have the capital needed to open the shop.

definition: a sign; a symbol; a mark.
example_en: The stone by the roadside was a mark of the boundary.

definition: to move or go forward or keep going; to progress.
example_en: The team slowly moved forward towards the goal.

definition: any of various mixtures of solid or semisolid triglycerides, that are soluble in organic solvents, found in adipose animal tissue; fat.
example_en: There was a lot of fat in the meat.

definition: a porridge made of wheat, rice or jowar floor with butter-milk.
example_en: She made ambalaka porridge for the afternoon meal.

definition: a stone pillar.
example_en: An ancient stone pillar stood in front of the temple.

definition: a mystical wand that has supernatural powers.
example: ಸಾಧು ತನ್ನ ಯೋಗದಂಡವನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The sage raised his mystical wand and blessed them.

definition: to include, contain (within oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥವು ಎಲ್ಲ ಜ್ಞಾನಶಾಖೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ತನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ತೞ್ಕಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That text contains within itself all branches of knowledge.

definition: a small jingling bell.
example_en: They had tied a small jingling bell to the child's leg.

definition: a connected group; a cluster; a bunch.
example_en: A bunch of bananas was hanging in the shop.

definition: to hit by throwing an object from a distance; to shoot.
example_en: The hunter shot the deer from a distance.

definition: orderliness; tidiness.
example_en: The tidiness of his room pleased everyone.

definition: the carrot-red colour.
example: ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಗಜ್ಜರೆಗೆಂಪು ಬಣ್ಣ ಬಹಳ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The carrot-red colour of that cloth was very beautiful.

definition: to become more in size, quantity, number or extent.
example_en: His wealth increased year by year.

definition: a period of six months.
example_en: He stayed in a foreign land for a period of six months.

definition: (pl.) in weaving, two strings or yarns.
example_en: The weaver arranged two yarns on the loom.

definition: the mother of one's grandfather or grand mother.
example_en: His great-grandmother was very old.

definition: the falling of rain along with the falling of hailstones.
example_en: Rain mixed with hailstones fell on the winter evening.

definition: of, belonging to man (Homo sapiens) or consisting of or produced by people; human.
example_en: His human wisdom is known to everyone.

definition: a place where electricity is generated on commercial scale; a generating station.
example_en: There is a big power generating station in this town.

definition: a thick stick or staff.
example_en: The old man was walking with the support of a thick staff.

definition: dexterity a) skill in using one's hands or body; adroitness; b) skill in using one's mind; cleverness.
example: ಅವನ ಕಡುಲುಳಿ ಚದುರಂಗದ ಆಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: His cleverness was clearly seen in the game of chess.

definition: any of the five arrows of the Love-God Kāma.
example_en: In the mythological story, Kama's love-arrow touched Shiva.

definition: to pass through an end of a thread through the eye of a needle.
example_en: The grandmother passed the thread through the eye of the needle.

definition: a man who cleans and prepares cotton for making yarns (as a profession); a carder.
example_en: The carder cleaned the cotton and prepared it for spinning.

definition: the site of a battle; a battlefield.
example_en: The historians researched that old battlefield.

definition: the main stem of a small plant, as lotus, amaranth, etc.
example: ಕೊಳದಲ್ಲಿ ತಾವರೆಯ ಕಾವು ನೀರಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಎದ್ದು ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The stem of the lotus stood up above the water in the pond.

definition: the place where a person or thing stands or is located, esp. an assigned post, position or location - as a) the place where a person, as a guard, stands while on duty; b) the post, building, base or headquarters assigned to a group of people working together, as in providing a service, making scientific observations, etc.; c) a place or region to which a naval fleet, ship, etc. is assigned for duty; a station.
example_en: There was heavy crowding of passengers at the train station.

definition: a woman of washermen caste; a washer-woman.
example_en: The washer-woman washed the clothes and spread them out to dry.

definition: any of an order (Isoptera) of pale-coloured social insects having a soft body and living in colonies composed of winged forms that mate and wingless workers and soldiers that are usu. sterile or immature, and which are very destructive to wooden structures and are found in the temperate zones and esp. in the tropics; a white ant; a termite.
example_en: Termites eat wooden furniture.

definition: a large black scorpion.
example_en: The large black scorpion was black and big.

definition: (fem.) an expert in deciphering ancient writings; palaeographer.
example_en: She works as a well-known palaeographer.

definition: gained, earned, accrued from one's past deeds.
example: ಈ ಸಂಪತ್ತು ಅವನ ಪೂರ್ವಾದತ್ತ ಪುಣ್ಯದ ಫಲ.
example_en: This wealth is the fruit of merit earned from his past deeds.

definition: to come out of sleep; to wake.
example_en: When the bell rang, he woke from sleep.

definition: to pull off or out; to pluck; to root.
example_en: He plucked the weed out from the ground.

definition: a person's employment, profession.
example_en: His earnings from employment are increasing every month.

definition: to become engrossed, absorbed in.
example_en: He was becoming engrossed in the sweetness of the song.

definition: one's eldest son.
example_en: The eldest son performed the father's last rites.

definition: a man who does not have any property or money and hence unable to clear his debts; a bankrupt.
example_en: Because of heavy debt he became a bankrupt.

definition: to make weak or weaker; to weaken; to render powerless, courageless.
example_en: The long illness weakened his body.

definition: a place where one normally resides; a house; a residence.
example_en: Their residence is on the bank of the river.

definition: he who has missed the path or gone astray.
example_en: That man who had gone astray lost his way in the forest.

definition: any of the daily rites that are to be carried out before the noon.
example_en: The brahmin finished the pre-noon rites and sat down to eat.

definition: the early part of the day.
example_en: He used to wake up in the early morning and go to the garden.

definition: having two meanings.
example_en: That word had two meanings and caused confusion.

definition: the bitter, alkaline, yellow-brown or greenish fluid secreted by the liver and stored in the gall-bladder that helps in digestion, esp. of fats; bile.
example_en: Bile increases if one eats oily food.

definition: conscience which governs the mind; a moral sense.
example: ಅವನ ಒಳನುಡಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳದಂತೆ ತಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His inner voice of conscience stopped him from lying.

definition: to become larger, bigger in size, number, extent, degree, etc.
example_en: The village's population grew larger from year to year.

definition: a short, piece of wood pointed at one end, and thick at another; a peg.
example_en: The carpenter drove a peg into the piece of wood.

definition: to be absorbed; to be dissolved and assimilated.
example_en: Sugar gets dissolved and absorbed in water.

definition: a duty or tax levied on imported goods.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ವಿದೇಶಿ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಎಱಕುಮತಿ ವಿಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The government levied an import duty on foreign goods.

definition: a huge wall enclosing a town, palace, etc.; a fort-wall.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕೋಟೆಯ ಕಟಹ ಇನ್ನೂ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿದೆ.
example_en: The old fort's wall still stands strong.

definition: knowledge; erudition; wisdom.
example_en: The teacher possessed immense knowledge.

definition: in return; back.
example: ಅವನು ಎರವಲು ಪಡೆದ ಹಣವನ್ನು ವಾಪಸ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He gave back the money he had borrowed.

definition: to become stinking.
example_en: In the rainy season wet cloth becomes stinking.

definition: the external, male genital organ; the penis.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಮಗುವಿನ ಬುಲ್ಲಿ ಸೋಂಕಿಗೆ ಔಷಧಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine for the infection of the child's penis.

definition: the organ that pumps blood to and receives it from all parts of the body; the heart.
example_en: Her heart seemed to stop from the shock.

definition: the persons belonging to a country; the people; the nation.
example_en: The government is working for the welfare of this nation's people.

definition: a highly contagious viral infection of the lining of the trachea and bronchi, often epidemic, and usu. marked by fever, weakness, muscular aches.
example_en: The contagious fever spread widely in the village during the rainy season.

definition: a clan of muslims originally from Afghanistan.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನೇಕ ಪಟಾಣಿ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: Many Pathan families lived in that town.

definition: to dazzle another's eyes with blinding brightness.
example_en: The sunlight dazzled her eyes.

definition: that which cannot produce offspring; a barren female (as a sterile woman, animal or plant).
example: ಆ ಗೊಟ್ಟ ಹಸು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಕರು ಹಾಕಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That barren cow never gave birth to a calf.

definition: to curb; to bring under control.
example_en: The teacher curbed the disciple's anger.

definition: any animal that has a long or abnormally long, neck, as a crane, giraffe, camel, etc.
example_en: The long-necked camel walked in the sand.

definition: an eye that is opened (hence staring at).
example_en: The child was staring at its mother with wide-open eyes.

definition: the act or fact of keeping awake and alert, in order to look after, protect or guard; a watch; a vigil.
example_en: Those who keep watch do not feel sleepy.

definition: the quality or condition of being complicated or complex; complexity; complication.
example_en: The complexity of this plan confused everyone.

definition: a seeing from a distance.
example: ದೂರದರ್ಶನ ಎಂಬ ಪದದ ಅರ್ಥ ದೂರದಿಂದ ಕಾಣುವುದು.
example_en: The word 'dooradarshana' means seeing from a distance.

definition: the common spider of an order (Araneae) of small, chiefly land arachnids having a body composed of a cephalothorax bearing the legs and an abdomen bearing two or more pairs of spinnerets that spin the silk threads from which are made nests or webs for trapping insects.
example_en: A spider had spun a web in the corner of the wall.

definition: a humble, modest man.
example: ಆ ನಮ್ರಸ್ತ ಗುರುಗಳ ಎದುರು ತಲೆ ಬಾಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That humble man bowed his head before the teacher.

definition: any of the sciences that deal with inanimate matter or energy, as physics, chemistry, geology, etc.; physical sciene.
example_en: Physical science includes physics and chemistry.

definition: the habit of cheating, inflicting distress.
example_en: Everyone was fed up with his habit of cheating and troubling others.

definition: the state or an instance of being elevated.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಉನ್ನತಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಂತೋಷ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The economic upliftment of this region brought joy to everyone.

definition: lower region.
example_en: There was a small village in the lower region of the hill.

definition: the act or practice of reading.
example_en: Reading was going on quietly in the library.

definition: the action or an act of prostrating oneself or one's body, esp. as a sign of reverence or submission; the condition of being prostrated or lying prostrate; prostration.
example_en: The devotee prostrated himself before the god.

definition: a verbal message.
example_en: The messenger carried a verbal message to the king.

definition: without cost of payment; free.
example_en: That shopkeeper distributed the goods for free.

definition: to jump from above to a lower place.
example_en: The boy jumped down from the bridge into the river.

definition: a Mongol or Mongolian; a Mogul.
example_en: The Mogul kings are famous in the history of India.

definition: to begin to grow or germinate; to sprout.
example_en: The seed sprouted in the soil.

definition: to become worse.
example: ಔಷಧ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಮೇಲೂ ಅವನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಬಿಗಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His health became worse even after taking medicine.

definition: a feather of the long, brightly coloured upper tail of a peacock.
example_en: The peacock's tail feather shone in many colours.

definition: any red flower.
example_en: A red flower had bloomed in the garden.

definition: to realise, accept or recognise as correct.
example_en: Everyone accepted his words as correct.

definition: (hist.) a province in south-east China.
example_en: Historians have written about the Huna province.

definition: an opening through something; gap; an aperture: a hole.
example_en: There was a hole in that vessel.

definition: the climber Trichosanthes anguina of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: They have grown the padala creeper in the backyard.

definition: to support, hold up with or as with a prop; to prop up.
example_en: They propped up the wall with a pillar so it would not fall.

definition: water falling over a cliff or from a height; water-falls.
example_en: A waterfall was cascading down from the cliff of the hill.

definition: (harmony, congruity) to be lost.
example: ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವಿನ ಸೇರುವೆದಪ್ಪಿ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಂತಿ ಇಲ್ಲವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The harmony between the two of them was lost and peace vanished from the house.

definition: not similar or alike; different; dissimilar.
example_en: His opinion is dissimilar to mine.

definition: to desire or long for eagerly; to crave.
example_en: She was longing eagerly to nestle in her mother's lap.

definition: a way of doing, being, being done or happening; mode of action, occurrence, etc.: manner.
example: ಜನರು ತರತರ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಧರಿಸಿ ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People had come to the festival dressed in various manners of clothing.

definition: a female of Indian crane (Ardea sibirica).
example_en: The female crane stood on the bank of the lake.

definition: a chronic skin disease characterised by scaly, reddish patches; psoriasis.
example: ಅವನ ಚರ್ಮದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಂಗಲೆಸುಂಡಿನ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಗಳು ಕಾಣಿಸಿದವು.
example_en: Signs of psoriasis appeared on his skin.

definition: the direction to the left of a person standing against the rising sun.
example_en: He turned and stood towards the left direction.

definition: (pl.) two types, manners, kinds, etc.
example_en: There are two kinds of solutions to this problem.

definition: many; much; abundant; numerous; ample; large.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಮಾವಿನ ಫಸಲು ಬಹುಳವಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This year the mango harvest has come in abundance.

definition: connection; attachment.
example: ಆ ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಗಾಢವಾದ ಅನುಬಂಧ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a deep bond between those two.

definition: a kind of grass straws of which are used to weave mats.
example_en: The villagers weave mats from that kind of grass.

definition: any substance used as a drug in curing or preventing a disease, healing or relieving pain, etc.; a medicine.
example_en: The doctor gave good medicine for the fever.

definition: joy; gladness; pleasure; delight.
example_en: There was delight filled in the child's smile.

definition: completely; fully; wholly.
example_en: He completed the work fully.

definition: a stout pillar for wrestlers to practise gymnastic feats.
example_en: The wrestlers exercised beside the stout pillar.

definition: (a dog, wolf, etc.) to utter the characteristic long, loud, wailing cry; to howl.
example_en: A dog howled in the distance.

definition: the act of colliding or coming together with sudden, violent force; a collision.
example_en: A collision of two buses occurred on the road.

definition: a spicy eatable made of bengal gram flour.
example_en: Mother made bengal gram flour snack in the evening.

definition: a person who goes before, preparing the way for others; a pioneer.
example: ಹೊಸ ಯೋಜನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನೇ ಮುಂದಾಳ್ ಆಗಿ ನಿಂತನು.
example_en: He stood as the pioneer leading the new project.

definition: a small bag that is sewed or inserted in a garment so that it is open at the top or side, for carrying money and small articles; a pocket.
example_en: He kept the money in his pocket.

definition: the prolonged buzzing sound (as of a bee or bees).
example_en: A prolonged buzzing sound was heard from the beehive.

definition: to revolve, rotate rapidly on an axis or on the circumference of a circle.
example_en: The top spun rapidly around in the wind.

definition: iron that is shaped by hammering or beating while it is hot.
example: ಕಮ್ಮಾರ ಕುಶಿಯನ್ನು ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಬಡಿದು ಆಕಾರ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The blacksmith hammered the hot iron and gave it shape.

definition: anything that adds grace or beauty; anything serving to adorn; decoration; embellishment.
example_en: New decoration was added to the temple tower.

definition: an order; a command.
example_en: The soldiers obeyed the officer's command.

definition: a moving stairway consisting of treads linked in an endless belt, used for going up or down, without oneself moving.
example: ಮಗು ಚರಸೋಪಾನದ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಂತು ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಗಿತು.
example_en: The child stood on the escalator and moved upward.

definition: a short, thick staff, tapered at one end, used for muscular exercise.
example: ಅವನು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಲೋಡು ಬೀಸಿ ಮೈ ಕಸರತ್ತು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He does muscular exercise every day swinging the exercise club.

definition: glitteringly; splendidly.
example: ವಜ್ರದ ಆಭರಣ ದೀಪದ ಬೆಳಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಫಳಫಳನೆ ಹೊಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The diamond ornament glittered splendidly in the lamp light.

definition: to push, thrust in (usu. using force).
example_en: The thieves broke the door and pushed themselves inside.

definition: a man in happy, safe condition; a happy man.
example: ಆ ಪದುಳಿಗ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯ ಬದುಕು ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That happy man led a peaceful life in the village.

definition: the act of determining the value or price of anything; evaluation; appraisal; valuation.
example_en: The officer carried out the valuation of the land.

definition: in great quantity or vehemence; vehemently; excessively.
example_en: He ate excessively and filled his stomach.

definition: to wander (without a purpose).
example_en: He wandered around the town without any purpose.

definition: scortching sunlight.
example_en: Everyone hesitated to walk in the scorching sunlight.

definition: the plant Schinus roxburghii of Araliaceae family.
example_en: The children were playing under the Schinus roxburghii tree.

definition: to draw or pull out.
example_en: The farmer pulled out the weed by its root.

definition: Brahma, the creator of the world or worlds.
example_en: In the puranas, Brahma the world-father is called the creator.

definition: a carpenteṛs tool, having an inclined, adjustable blade, for paring, truing, leveling or smoothing a wood surface.
example: ಬಡಗಿ ಹತ್ತರಿಯಿಂದ ಮರದ ಹಲಗೆಯನ್ನು ನಯವಾಗಿ ಕೆತ್ತಿದನು.
example_en: The carpenter smoothed the wooden plank with a plane.

definition: to cause to lick with the tongue.
example_en: She made the cat lick the milk with its tongue.

definition: the colour of the clear sky or the deep sea; blue.
example_en: The blue colour of the sky is very beautiful.

definition: (law.) a discretionary writ from a higher court to a lower one or to a board or official with some judicial power, requesting the record of a case for review; certiorari.
example: ಉಚ್ಚ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಆ ಪ್ರಕರಣದ ಮೇಲೆ ಉತ್ಪ್ರೇಷಣ ಹೊರಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The high court issued a writ of certiorari on that case.

definition: that is to be or fit to be sold; saleable.
example_en: They sent these saleable goods to the market.

definition: turned to or facing two (opposite) sides.
example_en: That hillock had a road facing two opposite sides.

definition: established; installed.
example_en: A new school was established in the town.

definition: a drawing or squeezing of milk from the mammary glands of (a cow, buffalo, etc.).
example_en: The cowherd milked the cow in the morning.

definition: the condition of being vexed; vexation.
example: ಕೆಲಸ ಕೈಗೂಡದೆ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಮೆ ತುಂಬಿತು.
example_en: His mind filled with vexation as the work did not succeed.

definition: a sharp, keen look.
example_en: The hunter observed the forest with a sharp, keen look.

definition: with no name; being anonymous.
example_en: His letter was anonymous.

definition: (the relation) to get strained or spoiled.
example_en: Because of a small quarrel, the relation between the two got strained.

definition: the work of cotton cleaning and preparing it for making yarns.
example_en: She was an expert in the work of carding cotton.

definition: a variety of deer.
example_en: Chamuru deer were running in the forest.

definition: (used reflexively for plural numbers) that or those belonging to the speakers or persons referred to by the speakers.
example: ಇದು ತಮತ್ತು ಮನೆಯೆಂದು ಅವರು ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: They proudly said this is their own house.

definition: a lump or clod of earth or clay.
example_en: The child built a play house from a lump of clay.

definition: a wide stretch of open land; a plain.
example_en: The farmers grew crops in the wide field.

definition: to yield a fruit or fruits.
example_en: The old coconut tree still yields fruit.

definition: a person whose head is infested with lice.
example: ಈರುದಲೆಯ ತಲೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛಗೊಳಿಸಲು ವಿಶೇಷ ಶ್ರಮ ಬೇಕು.
example_en: Special effort is needed to clean the head of a person infested with lice.

definition: a sound; an utterance.
example_en: The sound of the bell came from the temple.

definition: the non-venomous snake, Tortrix cylindrophis rufus, a short tailed earth snake with a depressed rounded head not distinct from the neck and a tail very short, conical and smooth at the end.
example_en: The irtalehāvu snake is not venomous.

definition: to become useless, sterile.
example_en: Without proper use, that machine became useless.

definition: a covering for the hand, made of leather, cloth, etc., with a separate cover for each finger and the thumb, used to keep the hand warm; a glove.
example_en: He wore gloves during winter.

definition: a loop formed in a rope, cord, etc.; a noose; a loop.
example: ಆ ಹಗ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಕಣ್ಣಿಗಣ್ ಹಾಕಿ ಕಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದನು.
example_en: He put a noose loop in that rope and tied it to the post.

definition: the effect or influence of the speech or language.
example: ಅವನ ವಾಙ್ಮಹಿಮೆ ಜನರ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಹಳ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರಿತು.
example_en: The influence of his speech had a great effect on the people.

definition: (fig.) lustre of the eye.
example_en: The lustre of her eyes enchanted everyone.

definition: being in the form of a coil; wound about a centre in an enlarging or decreasing continuous circular motion, either on a flat plane or rising in a cone; coiled.
example_en: The snake lay coiled up.

definition: the hollow under the arm under the shoulder; the armpit; axilla.
example_en: The doctor detected a lump at the armpit.

definition: a coin of smallest denomination or value (now archaic).
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದಮ್ಮಡಿಗೂ ಬೆಲೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: In olden times even a dammadi coin had value.

definition: he who guides towards or shows direction, course; a guide.
example_en: That guide showed the way to the travelers.

definition: something that causes vibration, esp. a device used in a mechanical sieve or for agitating something; a vibrator.
example_en: The vibrator of the sieve is not working properly.

definition: (the air compressed into a tube, bag, balloon, etc.) to be released.
example_en: The air in the tyre got released and the vehicle stopped.

definition: the fleshy part of a fruit.
example: ಈ ಮಾವಿನ ಹಣ್ಣಿನ ಕುಸಿರು ಬಹಳ ಸಿಹಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The flesh of this mango is very sweet.

definition: the cardinal number between seven and nine; 8.
example_en: There were eight apples in that box.

definition: an auspicious celebration.
example_en: The auspicious celebration took place with festivity in the village.

definition: busy and noisy activity caused by enthusiasm, excitement, etc.; bustle.
example_en: There was loud, busy bustle in the wedding house.

definition: a sound.
example_en: The sound of the bell was heard far away.

definition: the best or most preferable ones that are selected; choice.
example_en: The best colours were selected in the competition.

definition: a rough, confused fight; scuffle.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಅಡರಾಟ ನಡೆದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಓಡಿಬಂದರು.
example_en: A scuffle broke out between the two, and everyone came running.

definition: to teach reading and writing; to make literate.
example_en: The teacher taught the children to read and write.

definition: to become equal; to equal.
example_en: These two numbers will never become equal.

definition: the process of accounting.
example: ಕಚೇರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರಾವರ್ದು ಕೆಲಸ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The accounting work is carried out every month in the office.

definition: boldness or determination in facing great danger, esp. in battle; heroic courage; bravery.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕನಿಗೆ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿದ ಪೆಟ್ಟು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That soldier's bravery shown in the war earned everyone's admiration.

definition: a going or moving upwards.
example_en: The upward movement of the smoke was towards the sky.

definition: a being praised, extolled.
example_en: The poets sang the king's praise in their songs.

definition: the tendency or inclination of a person to have illicit and unrestrained sexual relations.
example_en: Everyone knew about his tendency towards illicit relations.

definition: a contagious disease, the most common form of plague, caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis transmitted by fleas from infected rats, and characterised by buboes, fever, prostration, and delirium; bubonic plague.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಟುಬೇನೆ ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನೇ ಆವರಿಸಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In olden times, the bubonic plague had spread through the entire village.

definition: a mechanical toy to play with for children, that can be operated by winding up its spring.
example_en: The child wound up the mechanical toy and played with it.

definition: a small cup for drinking liquids; a cup.
example_en: Grandfather drank milk from a silver cup.

definition: a man who is alone; a lonely man.
example: ಆ ಒತ್ತೆ ಕಾಡಿನ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಗುಡಿಸಲಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That lonely man lived in a hut in the middle of the forest.

definition: an officer for collecting the tax hanasu.
example_en: The tax officer collected the hanasu tax.

definition: a nomadic Romany caste.
example_en: The Sukkaliga caste led a nomadic life.

definition: to cry 'victory'; to shout a victory cry.
example_en: The soldiers came into the town shouting victory.

definition: (dial.) the lid of a kitchen utensil.
example_en: She forgot the lid of the kitchen utensil in the kitchen.

definition: any defect that makes a woman unable to bear a child.
example_en: She could not bear children because of a defect of the womb.

definition: a house different than the one being referred to.
example_en: After the wedding she went to a different house.

definition: a washed sari (sīre, a garment worn by Hindu women, consisting of a long piece of cotton or silk wrapped around the body with one end draped over the head or over one shoulder).
example_en: She wore a freshly washed sari for the worship.

definition: a cloth in gen.
example: ಆಕೆ ಹೊಸ ಶಾಲೆ ಖರೀದಿಸಲು ಅಂಗಡಿಗೆ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: She went to the shop to buy new cloth.

definition: a servant in a formal official uniform.
example_en: That uniformed servant came along with the officer.

definition: to become solid, compact, etc.; to solidify.
example_en: The soil becomes solid in the sun.

definition: to give, in words, a detailed account of; to describe.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ತನ್ನ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ವಿಸ್ತಾರವಾಗಿ ಬನ್ನಣೆಗೆಯ್ದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother described her village story in detail.

definition: the superiority of a country, territorial region.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ನೆಲಬಲಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ತಿಳಿದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In that era, the superiority of that country was known to all.

definition: glitteringly; sparklingly; radiantly.
example_en: The stars were shining sparklingly in the sky.

definition: the quality, state or fact of being wrinkled, contracted.
example_en: The wrinkled, contracted state of that cloth did not look good.

definition: hung by a support from above; suspended.
example_en: The lamp was suspended from the ceiling.

definition: to have depth.
example_en: That pond had considerable depth.

definition: the large, deciduous tree Steriospermum suaveolens ( = Bignonia suaveolens) of Bignoniaceae family.
example_en: In this forest, hude trees are abundant.

definition: excessive arrogance; haughty snobbishness.
example_en: Out of excessive arrogance, he would not listen to anyone.

definition: green grass used as food by grazing animals.
example_en: The cows were grazing on the green grass.

definition: to undergo preparatory consecration before a religious sacrifice or other ceremonies.
example_en: The disciple underwent consecration under the guru.

definition: unnecessary or unreasonable expenditure.
example_en: The household budget was ruined by unnecessary extravagant expenditure.

definition: to become lazy; to dislike or avoid work.
example_en: He becomes lazy about studying.

definition: the chief of a battalion or regiment.
example_en: The battalion chief led the army.

definition: the act of greeting or welcoming by gestures or words; salutations.
example_en: They greeted the guests with salutations and invited them inside.

definition: goods brought from across the border; imported merchandise.
example_en: Inspection of the imported merchandise took place at the port.

definition: to excel other in quality, numbers.
example_en: That student excelled everyone in the examination.

definition: an abnormally swollen part of the body caused by a disease.
example_en: A swelling appeared on his leg.

definition: at that time; then.
example_en: At that time he was not in the town.

definition: a man who does not leak out secrets.
example_en: The man who does not leak secrets told no one the secret.

definition: transparent, colourless or slightly tinged quartz; a crystal.
example_en: The necklace made of crystal beads was beautiful.

definition: the tree Grewia asiatica of Tiliaceae family.
example_en: The villagers plucked the fruits of the parushaka tree.

definition: a man who sells meat; a butcher.
example: ಆ ಸೂನಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಂಸ ಮಾರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That butcher sells meat in the market every day.

definition: a colour that is the mixture of sky-blue, black or white hues in different proportion.
example: ಆಕಾಶದ ಊದಿ ಬಣ್ಣ ಸಂಜೆಯ ಸೊಬಗನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The bluish-grey colour of the sky enhanced the evening's beauty.

definition: having no shadow; shadowless.
example_en: That light, being shadowless, spread everywhere.

definition: formal dissolution of a marriage; permanent separation of a husband and wife; divorce.
example: ಗಂಡ ಮೂರು ಬಾರಿ ತಲ್ಲಾಕ್ ಹೇಳಿ ಬೇರ್ಪಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The husband pronounced talaq three times and separated.

definition: name of a country in in Asia Minor having an area of 301381 sq. miles and Ankara as its capital; Turkey.
example_en: The history of the country of Turkey is very ancient.

definition: a stretch of elevated land without having trees and other plants except grass.
example_en: The goats were grazing on the treeless grassy upland.

definition: a more or less rigid floating platform made of buoyant material or materials as logs, boards, etc.; a raft.
example: ಬೆಸ್ತರು ತೆಪ್ಪದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ನದಿ ದಾಟಿದರು.
example_en: The fishermen sat on a raft and crossed the river.

definition: a king.
example_en: The king set out for war with his army.

definition: a roof (esp. pandal) that is oblique.
example_en: When the rain came, water leaked through the oblique pandal roof.

definition: with one's free will and agreeably; sincerely and whole-heartedly.
example_en: She bowed to the elders whole-heartedly.

definition: a false statement; falsehood; lie.
example_en: It turned out that everything he said was a lie.

definition: the unburnt fire-brand.
example_en: An unburnt firebrand fell out from the hearth.

definition: anything given as an equivalent or to make amends for a loss; compensation.
example_en: The company gave compensation to the accident victims.

definition: a garden area.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಹಿಂಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ತೋಟಗಟ್ಟು ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a beautiful garden area behind the house.

definition: shallow knowledge in any field.
example: ಅವನ ಬಡಬಿಜ್ಜೆ ಯಿಂದ ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ಕೆಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: This work was spoiled by his shallow knowledge.

definition: the feeling, thinking of an ardent devotee who has surrendered totally to the god.
example_en: The devotee's mind was filled with the feeling of total surrender to god.

definition: a loop for hooking on.
example: ಅವಳ ಸೀರೆಗೆ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಕುಣಿಕೆ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಹಿಡಿದಿಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: She attached a hooking loop to her sari and held it firmly.

definition: the state or fact of coming out of sleep, stupor, trance etc.; the state of being or staying awake; wakefulness.
example_en: He was awake the whole night.

definition: (used with the verbs 'jigi', 'hāru' meaning to spring, to jump, etc.) suddenly; immediately.
example_en: He suddenly got up and ran.

definition: a person meditating inwardly (without showing its sign outside).
example_en: That inwardly meditating man remained calm even amid the crowd.

definition: suddenly; happening without prior notice or knowledge.
example_en: Everyone got startled when the rain suddenly began to pour.

definition: a moving; movement.
example_en: The leaves of the tree swayed due to the movement of the wind.

definition: the central portion of a house.
example_en: She was standing in the central portion of the house.

definition: a large kettle-drum.
example_en: The soldiers set out in procession, beating the large kettle-drum (nakara).

definition: a string of gems and pearls.
example_en: A string of gems and pearls was shining on the queen's neck.

definition: pain preceding or accompanying menstruation.
example_en: When the menstrual pain became severe, she stayed at home.

definition: one's father.
example_en: The child held its father's hand.

definition: to leave a strip of land as a demarkation between two pieces of land.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ರೈತರು ತಮ್ಮ ಹೊಲಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಶಿಸ್ತುಬಿಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The two farmers left a demarcation strip between their fields.

definition: Viṣṇu.
example_en: There is an idol of Vasudeva (Vishnu) in the temple.

definition: (pl.) the two mammary glands in women; both the breasts of a woman.
example_en: She covered both her breasts with the sari.

definition: formed like a bud.
example_en: The sculptor carved a flower formed like a bud.
